faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Does balcony pooling always mean the grout has failed?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 阳台积水一定是填缝失效吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. Pooling can involve drainage, surface falls or outlet condition as well as joints and the wider waterproofing assembly. Renewing grout alone may not address the cause. Note where water collects and arrange assessment of the balcony before choosing a repair.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不一定。除接缝和整体防水构造外，积水也可能与排水、地面坡度或排水口状况有关。仅更新填缝未必能解决原因。记录积水位置，先评估阳台再选择维修。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Why assess balcony thresholds and outlets together?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 为什么要一起评估阳台门槛与排水口？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Door thresholds, outlets and adjoining junctions affect how water leaves the balcony and where it may enter the building. Their accessible condition and connection to the waterproofing need assessment together before a repair scope is agreed. Photos can help describe the area but do not confirm concealed details.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 门槛、排水口及相邻交接影响阳台排水及进入建筑的路径。确认维修范围前，应一起检查可接触部位及其与防水层的连接。照片有助于描述区域，但不能证实隐蔽细部。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Does a ceiling watermark show exactly where water enters the roof?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 天花板水印能准确显示屋顶进水位置吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. Water can travel before a mark appears, so the visible stain may be away from the entry point. Note whether moisture changes after rain and distinguish new dampness from old marks. Arrange safe assessment rather than treating the stain location as a diagnosis.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不能。水可能流动后才形成印迹，所以水渍位置可能偏离进水点。记录雨后湿度是否变化，区分新潮湿和旧印迹。应安排安全评估，不把水渍位置当作诊断。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can a roof coating replace safe access and assessment?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 屋面涂层能代替安全通行与现场评估吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. A coating does not remove the need to assess the roof condition, junctions, drainage and suitability of the selected system. Safe access and any separate repair work need to be agreed before application. Describe the symptoms from a safe location; do not climb onto the roof to investigate.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不能。涂层不能代替对屋顶状况、交接、排水及所选系统适用性的评估。涂刷前需确认安全通行和其他维修范围。请从安全位置描述现象，不要爬上屋顶调查。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: How do you repair a leaking shower?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 淋浴间漏水如何维修？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We assess the source first, then quote the suitable repair. Grout or silicone renewal may suit a joint problem; membrane renewal can require tile removal and coordinated retiling. Plumbing or waste leaks need a separate trade scope, so a visible stain alone does not establish membrane failure. Read the comparison of surface and membrane repairs for the limits of each option.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们先评估水源，再为适合的维修报价。填缝或硅胶更新可能适合接缝问题；防水膜更新可能需要拆砖及协调重新铺砖。供水或排水渗漏需独立工种处理，因此可见水渍不能证明膜层失效。参阅表面与防水膜修复对比，了解各方案的限制。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Do you provide pool waterproofing as well as poolside tiling?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 除了泳池周边贴砖，也承接泳池防水吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Yes. We provide pool-interior waterproofing and pool surround tiling as separate services. For the pool interior, we assess the existing lining, surfaces and junctions before specifying the waterproofing system and finish. Your quote identifies the agreed interior work separately from coping and terrace tiling.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 是的，我们提供泳池内部防水和泳池周边贴砖，两者分别明确施工范围。池内施工先评估现有内衬、表面及交接，再确定防水系统和饰面。报价将约定的池内工作与池沿压顶、露台贴砖区分列明。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Is waterproofing required before tiling a wet area?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 湿区贴砖前需要防水吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We install the specified wet-area waterproofing before the tiled finish, with surface preparation, drainage and junction details coordinated as part of the service. Tiles and grout alone do not provide the waterproofing layer.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们先完成指定湿区防水，再做瓷砖饰面，并协调表面准备、排水与交接细部。瓷砖和填缝本身不能提供防水层。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: How long does a waterproofing membrane last?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 防水膜能使用多久？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: There is no single service-life figure for every membrane. The installed system, base condition, movement, exposure and use affect performance. We assess accessible surfaces and explain any investigation or renewal needed; intact tiles alone do not establish the condition beneath them.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 所有防水膜没有统一使用年限。安装系统、基层状况、位移、暴露条件及使用方式都会影响性能。我们评估可接触表面，说明所需调查或更新；瓷砖完好不能证明下方状况。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can waterproofing be done without removing tiles?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不拆砖可以做防水吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: A local joint repair may be possible if assessment supports it. Regrouting or resealing does not replace a failed concealed membrane. We check the surface, joints and likely water-entry source, then identify any tile removal and membrane work in the written quote. The no-tile-removal explanation separates joint renewal from concealed membrane work.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 评估支持时，可考虑局部接缝维修。重新填缝或密封不能替换失效的隐蔽防水膜。我们检查表面、接缝及可能进水源，并在报价中列明拆砖与膜层施工。不拆砖维修说明区分接缝更新与隐蔽膜层施工。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can you waterproof over existing tiles?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可以在现有瓷砖上做防水吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: It depends on the selected system and the condition of the existing tiles and substrate. Waterproofing over tiles does not repair a failed concealed membrane. We inspect the area on site and specify any tile removal and preparation needed in the repair plan and written quote.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 取决于选定系统、现有瓷砖与基层状况。在砖面做防水不能修复失效的隐蔽膜层。我们到场检查，并在维修方案和报价中说明所需拆砖与基层准备。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Do I need to replace the whole bathroom?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 需要更换整个浴室吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Not every shower leak needs a whole bathroom replacement. Assessment helps distinguish a joint problem, a plumbing source and affected waterproofing. We explain whether a targeted repair is suitable or which layers and finishes need removal and renewal.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 并非每次淋浴漏水都需整体更换浴室。评估帮助区分接缝问题、管道水源及受损防水。我们说明局部维修是否适合，或哪些层次和饰面需要拆除更新。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What if the leak is already showing downstairs?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 楼下已出现漏水，应该怎么办？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Avoid using the affected shower while the source is assessed. Tell us when the leak appears and which areas are affected. We arrange access to the relevant areas and identify the repair scope; plumbing or other trade assessment may also be needed before retiling.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 在评估水源期间避免使用受影响淋浴。请说明渗漏时间及区域，我们安排进入相关位置并确认维修范围；重新贴砖前也可能需管道或其他工种评估。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can you repair one damaged tile without replacing the whole floor?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可以只修一块破损砖，不换整层地面吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We inspect the damaged tile and surrounding base before replacement. Matching tile availability, access and any underlying damage determine the scope. Your quote identifies the repair area and any preparation or waterproofing work needed.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们在更换前检查破损砖及周边基层。匹配砖供应、通行及底层损坏决定范围。报价会说明维修区域，以及所需准备或防水工作。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What is included in tile regrouting and shower resealing?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 重新填缝与淋浴密封包含哪些工作？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Regrouting renews grout between tiles; resealing renews silicone at movement junctions and edges. We remove the deteriorated material, prepare the included joints and install suitable replacements. Neither process replaces a failed membrane, so recurring leaks need source assessment before the repair scope is agreed.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 重新填缝更新瓷砖间填缝；重新密封更新伸缩交接和边缘硅胶。我们去除老化材料、准备约定接缝并安装适当替换材料。两者均不能替换失效膜层，反复漏水需先评估水源再确定维修。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can you tile over existing tiles?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可以在旧砖上再贴一层砖吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Over-tiling may suit a sound, well-bonded base with acceptable flatness and finished height. We assess those conditions, edges and transitions before confirming the scope. Loose tiles or a failed concealed waterproofing layer need their own preparation or repair; another tile layer does not fix them.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 稳固、粘结良好且平整度和完成面高度合适时，可能适合覆盖铺砖。我们先评估这些条件、边缘及过渡，再确认范围。松砖或失效隐蔽防水层需单独处理；再加一层砖不能修复它们。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Do you supply tiles or install tiles I have selected?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 你们供砖，还是安装我选择的瓷砖？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We install your selected tiles or include tile supply in the agreed scope. We confirm quantities, format, thickness and responsibility for materials before work begins. You can contact Ellis before choosing or buying tiles.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们可安装您选定的瓷砖，也可按约定范围包含材料供应。开工前确认数量、规格、厚度及材料责任。选择或购买瓷砖前就可以联系 Ellis。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Why does floor flatness matter with large tiles?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 大规格瓷砖为什么重视基层平整度？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Larger tiles can bridge variations in the base, affecting support, alignment and preparation. Flatness is different from making every floor level: the intended falls and complete floor build-up still matter. Our large-tile base preparation guidance explains what needs assessment before installation and quoting.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 大砖可能跨过基层起伏，影响支撑、对齐及准备工作。平整不等于所有地面都要水平，预定排水坡度和完整地面构造仍很重要。大砖基层准备指南说明安装和报价前需要评估的内容。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What should I check at floor tile height transitions?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 地砖与相邻地面的高度过渡要检查什么？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We check the complete floor build-up at adjoining rooms, doors and appliances before installation. Tile thickness, adhesive and base preparation together determine the finished height. We plan the transitions with the layout; see floor height transitions and connected-room layout for the details to check.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 安装前，我们核对相邻房间、门口及设备位置的完整地面厚度。砖厚、胶层与基层处理共同决定完成面高度，并结合排布安排过渡。请参阅 地面高度过渡与连通房间排砖 了解检查细节。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Should the benchtop be settled before splashback tiling?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 厨房台面确定后才能贴防溅墙吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We plan the splashback from the final benchtop position and check the wall and any gaps left by replacement work before tiling. We use a suitable flexible detail at movement junctions. See wall and benchtop readiness before arranging the work.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们根据最终台面位置规划防溅墙，贴砖前检查墙面及更换留下的缝隙，并在位移交接处采用合适的柔性接缝。请参阅 墙面与台面就绪要求 ，再安排施工。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: How do I plan splashback cuts around outlets and a cooktop?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 防溅墙插座和灶台周边如何安排切砖？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We plan the tile layout around outlets, exposed edges and the final benchtop. We check materials and clearances against the appliance instructions and applicable installation requirements; plumbing and electrical changes have their own trade scope. Our splashback layout and material guidance explains the assessment points.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们围绕插座、外露边缘和最终台面规划排砖，按设备说明及适用安装要求核对材料和间距；管道与电气改动分别明确工种范围。我们的 防溅墙排砖与材料指南 说明评估要点。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Does waterproofing go down before or after the screed?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 防水膜在找平砂浆之前还是之后施工？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: There is no universal before-or-after rule. The specified waterproofing system determines whether the membrane sits above or below the screed or tile bed. Ellis confirms the project sequence before construction, coordinating drainage falls, junctions, finished tile height and the required waiting stages. Changing that sequence needs review of the complete system.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 没有统一前后顺序。指定防水系统决定膜层在找平层或瓷砖垫层之上还是之下。Ellis 在施工前确认顺序，协调排水坡度、交接、完成面高度与等待阶段。改变顺序需复核完整系统。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can I keep the existing shower position?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可以保留现有淋浴位置吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: It may be possible, depending on the layout, existing waste and drainage falls. We assess those details before membrane and tile installation. Any plumbing changes are a separate trade scope, with responsibilities and timing confirmed before the affected stages begin.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可能可以，取决于布局、现有排水及坡度。我们在防水与贴砖前评估。管道改动属于独立工种，相关工序开始前确认责任和时间。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What if the existing waterproofing looks fine?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 现有防水看起来完好，还需要处理吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Appearance alone cannot confirm the concealed membrane's condition. We inspect the wet area, identify which layers the renovation will remove and explain the assessed renewal scope. If removal exposes extra substrate work, we obtain written approval before it proceeds.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 外观不能证实隐蔽膜层状况。我们检查湿区，确定翻新会拆除哪些层次，并说明评估后的更新范围。拆除发现额外基层工作，会先获得书面确认再施工。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What waterproofing and tiling services do you provide?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 你们提供哪些防水与贴砖服务？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We provide bathroom and wet-area waterproofing, wall and floor tiling, tile repairs, regrouting, shower resealing and pool surround tiling across Adelaide. We also assess and carry out roof, balcony, exterior wall and pool-interior waterproofing, selecting the system and scope for the existing surface and project requirements.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们在阿德莱德提供浴室与湿区防水、墙地面贴砖、瓷砖维修、重新填缝、淋浴密封及泳池周边贴砖，也承接屋顶、阳台、外墙和泳池内部防水。团队评估现有表面及项目要求，再确定适合的系统和施工范围。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What determines a waterproofing or tiling quote?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 哪些因素决定防水或贴砖报价？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We assess the area, base condition, tile format, cuts, access and materials before quoting. Your itemised quote identifies the preparation, removal, substrate repairs, material supply, edges and joints, waste arrangements and finish included. We distinguish separate trades and exclusions and explain how additional findings affect cost or timing. Use the quote comparison checklist to compare the same scope.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们评估面积、基层状况、砖规格、切割、通行和材料后报价。分项报价列明包含的准备、拆除、基层维修、材料供应、边缘接缝、清运安排与饰面，区分独立工种和不包含项目，并说明额外发现对费用或时间的影响。使用 报价对比清单 比较相同范围。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: How are waterproofing and tiling scheduled?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 防水和贴砖如何安排工序？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We coordinate preparation, membrane application, readiness checks, tiling and finishing for the selected system. We explain the waiting stages and which areas need to remain clear so you can plan household access. Surface dry, ready to recoat, ready to tile and ready for use are different milestones, confirmed against the product instructions and site conditions. See our drying and curing milestones when arranging household access.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们按选定系统协调基层准备、防水膜施工、就绪检查、贴砖与收尾，并说明各等待阶段及需要保持空置的区域，方便您安排家中通行。表干、可重涂、可贴砖和可使用是不同节点，均按产品说明与现场条件确认。请参阅 干燥与养护节点 ，安排家庭日常通行。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: When can I use the completed bathroom or tiled area?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 完工浴室或瓷砖区域什么时候能使用？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We confirm likely downtime before work and explain when you can walk on, clean or expose the finished area to water at handover. These uses can have different waiting periods, based on the installed adhesive, grout and silicone, their product instructions and site conditions. Readiness to tile is a separate stage, and a touch-dry surface alone does not confirm readiness for use. The return-to-use guide explains why appearance alone is not a readiness check.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 开工前，我们说明预计停用时间；交付时解释何时可以踩踏、清洁或接触水。这些用途的等待要求取决于所用瓷砖胶、填缝及硅胶的产品说明和现场条件。可贴砖是另一施工节点，表面摸起来干燥并不代表已能使用。 恢复使用指南 解释为什么外观不能作为就绪检查。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What happens if additional damage is found during removal?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 拆除时发现额外损坏怎么办？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We explain the exposed condition and the additional work required, including its cost and timing. Extra work is confirmed with you in writing before it proceeds.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们说明打开后的状况、额外工作及其费用和时间，获得您的书面确认后再施工。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What do you provide at handover?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 交付时会提供什么？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We explain the completed work and provide care and return-to-use instructions for the installed materials. Your written scope identifies the preparation, installation, checks and records agreed for the project. Ask about any applicable product and workmanship terms before booking; they are separate and depend on the agreed scope. Our handover and warranty questions help you clarify the job-specific records and terms.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们解释已完成工作，并提供所用材料的保养与恢复使用说明。书面范围列明约定的准备、安装、检查和记录。预约前请询问适用产品及施工条款，两者分别适用并取决于约定范围。交付与保修问题清单帮助明确项目记录和条款。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What should I arrange for a rental or strata property?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 出租房或分层物业需要安排什么？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Share the property location, affected room or surface, what you have observed and when it occurs. Provide the owner, property manager or strata contact, who can authorise work, and access arrangements for the affected and adjoining areas. Let us know about tenant appointments, keys, parking or building entry restrictions. Confirm authority before booking; our assessment describes the work and does not decide ownership boundaries, legal liability or who must pay.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 请提供位置、受影响房间或表面、观察到的情况及时间，以及业主、物业经理或 strata 联系人、授权人和相关区域通行安排。请说明租客预约、钥匙、停车或楼宇限制。预约前确认授权；我们的评估说明施工需求，不决定产权边界、法律责任或付款责任。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Should I book an assessment or a repair for a roof leak that only happens in wind-driven rain?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 只在风雨交加时屋顶才漏水，应先预约排查还是直接维修？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Start with the rain pattern and the affected indoor area. We assess accessible roof surfaces and junctions before confirming whether local waterproofing is suitable. Tell us when the leak starts, any known wind direction and previous repairs. The written scope distinguishes inspection, the proposed repair, access and any further investigation or separate roof work.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 先说明降雨规律与室内受影响部位。我们检查可安全接近的屋顶表面与节点，再确认是否适合局部防水处理。请说明何时开始漏水、已知风向及旧维修情况。书面范围会区分检查、拟定修复、进场条件，以及可能需要的进一步排查或独立屋顶工程。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Does a balcony leak after rain need new grout, joint sealing or a new membrane?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 阳台雨后渗漏，需要换填缝、修密封接缝还是更新防水层？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: The entry path and condition beneath the tiles determine the choice. Grout renewal treats tile joints, flexible sealing treats suitable movement junctions, and membrane renewal treats a different layer with its own removal and reinstatement scope. We check thresholds, falls, outlet connections and the accessible base before recommending what can be retained.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 应根据进水路径与砖下状况选择。填缝更新处理砖缝，弹性密封处理适用的活动接缝，防水层更新则处理另一层构造，并涉及相应拆除与恢复。我们检查门槛、坡度、排水口连接与可见基层，再建议哪些部分可以保留。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What should I describe if rain enters beside a window or through a wall?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 窗边或墙面雨天进水时，应说明哪些情况？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Describe the wall direction, when moisture first appears and whether a nearby balcony, roof edge or window junction is also wet. A stain beside a window does not locate the source on its own. We assess accessible wall waterproofing details; window-unit or glazing repairs and separate drainage work require their own scope.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 请说明墙面朝向、何时最先受潮，以及附近阳台、屋顶边缘或窗边交接处是否同时变湿。窗边水渍本身不能定位进水来源。我们评估可安全接近的墙体防水节点；窗体、玻璃维修及独立排水工程需另行明确范围。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Why do courtyard tiles hold puddles when the surface grate is clear?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 排水格栅没有杂物，庭院砖面为什么仍积水？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: A clear grate does not establish the condition or capacity of the pipe below. Tile-bed low spots, falls, outlet height and adjoining ground levels also influence surface drainage. We assess the tiled surface and base for a retiling scope. Suspected pipe blockage or damage needs separate drainage assessment before surface work is planned.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 格栅清洁并不能确认下方管道的状况或排水能力。铺砖层低洼、坡度、排水口高度及相邻地面高度也会影响表面排水。我们评估砖面与基层，明确重新铺砖范围。若怀疑管道堵塞或损坏，应先另行进行排水评估，再安排表面工程。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can outdoor tiling start as soon as the surface looks dry after rain?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 雨后表面看起来干了，就能开始户外铺砖吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Appearance alone is not a readiness check. Moisture in the substrate, the retained tile bed and existing coatings need assessment against the selected membrane and adhesive requirements. Application conditions, protection from rain and return-to-use stages can differ. We confirm the installation sequence for the materials and actual site conditions.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 仅凭外观不能判断是否具备施工条件。基层含水状况、保留铺砖层与旧涂层，需要对照所选防水材料和瓷砖胶要求进行评估。施工条件、防雨保护与恢复使用阶段可能不同。我们按实际材料与现场条件确认施工顺序。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: What should a rainwater leak repair quote include before retiling?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 雨水渗漏修复后重新铺砖，报价应包含哪些内容？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Compare the assessed entry path, removal area, base repairs, membrane boundary and connection to outlets or thresholds. Check whether tile supply, adhesive, grout, flexible joints, waste removal and reinstatement are included. Access, weather protection, readiness checks and any separate trade work should be clear. Concealed findings can change the scope and need written agreement before extra work proceeds.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 应比较已评估的进水路径、拆除区域、基层修复、防水边界及与排水口或门槛的连接方式。确认是否包含瓷砖供应、瓷砖胶、填缝、弹性接缝、废料处理与饰面恢复。进场、防雨保护、施工条件检查及其他工种范围也应明确。隐蔽问题可能改变范围，额外工作开始前需书面商定。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: How do porcelain, ceramic and natural stone differ?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 瓷质砖、陶瓷砖与天然石材有什么区别？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Porcelain is a dense, low-absorption type of ceramic material, although Australian retail ranges commonly list porcelain and ceramic separately. Ceramic ranges include wall and floor products; natural stone is quarried material identified by its stone type. We check the actual product designation and intended use. The finish, weight, thickness and fixing requirements still need review for your surface.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 瓷质砖属于砖体致密、吸水率较低的陶瓷材料，但澳洲零售产品通常将 Porcelain 与 Ceramic 分列。Ceramic 系列既有墙砖也有地砖；天然石材则是按具体石种区分的开采材料。我们核对实际产品分类和用途，同时评估饰面、重量、厚度与对应表面的粘贴要求。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Are matt tiles automatically suitable for bathroom floors and pool surrounds?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 哑光砖一定适合浴室地面和泳池周边吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. Matt describes appearance, not verified slip performance. We review the selected product’s wet-use slip information and proposed location, including barefoot comfort at a pool edge. Drainage, grout joints, cleaning and the coping profile also matter. A wall tile or polished finish should not be selected for a wet floor solely because its colour matches.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不一定。哑光描述外观，并不代表经过核实的防滑表现。我们核对具体产品的湿态防滑资料和拟用位置，泳池边沿还要考虑赤脚舒适度。排水、砖缝、清洁与压顶边型也很重要。不能仅因颜色匹配，就将墙砖或抛光饰面用于湿态地面。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Which bathroom wall tiles are easier to clean, and can water marks still show?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 哪些浴室墙砖更容易清洁？还会出现水迹吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: We compare smooth glazed ceramic and porcelain with the proposed wall use and cleaning routine. A smooth surface can make wiping easier, but dried water and soap deposits may still show. Gloss and satin change the appearance; textured surfaces and mosaic joints change the cleaning detail. Use the tile and grout care instructions, and keep the separate waterproofing scope clear.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 我们结合墙面用途与日常清洁习惯，比较平滑釉面陶瓷砖和瓷质砖。平滑表面通常便于擦洗，但仍可能显现干水迹和皂垢。亮面与缎光改变外观，纹理表面和马赛克砖缝则改变清洁细节。应遵循瓷砖及填缝养护说明，同时明确独立的防水工作范围。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Which splashback tiles make cooking splashes easier to clean?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 哪些厨房防溅墙砖更方便清洁烹饪溅污？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Smooth glazed ceramic or porcelain is worth comparing with deeply textured tiles and small mosaics. Check the actual surface, exposed grout and product cleaning instructions rather than relying on a gloss or matt label. We assess tile layout, cement-based or epoxy grout suitability and the flexible benchtop junction. Materials near the cooktop also need to suit the appliance instructions and project requirements.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 可将平滑釉面陶瓷砖或瓷质砖，与深纹理砖和小规格马赛克进行比较。应核对实际表面、外露填缝及产品清洁说明，不能仅凭亮面或哑光名称判断。我们评估排砖、水泥基或环氧填缝的适用性，以及台面弹性接缝。灶具附近材料还需符合电器说明与项目要求。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Do stone, terrazzo and cement tiles need the same care as porcelain?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 石材、水磨石和水泥砖的养护与瓷质砖相同吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Use the actual material’s care instructions. Marble, limestone and travertine can be affected by acidic cleaners, while real terrazzo, cement and terracotta products may have specific sealing requirements. Sealing is not a substitute for a wet-area membrane or a promise against every stain. Stone-look or terrazzo-look porcelain is porcelain with that appearance, not the natural or cement-based material it resembles.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 应按实际材质的养护说明处理。大理石、石灰石和洞石可能受酸性清洁剂影响，真正水磨石、水泥砖和陶土砖可能有特定封护要求。封护不能代替湿区防水层，也不代表能抵御所有污渍。仿石或仿水磨石瓷质砖仍是相应外观的瓷质砖，并非它所模仿的天然或水泥基材料。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Do mosaic, rectified and stone-look identify the tile material?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 马赛克、精修边与仿石，说明的是瓷砖材质吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. Mosaic describes a format, rectified describes the edge treatment and stone-look describes appearance. A mosaic may be glass, porcelain, ceramic or stone. Polished, matt, gloss and lappato describe different surface finishes. We record the actual material, size, finish and installation location together so the adhesive, joints, edges and care can be assessed correctly.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不是。马赛克描述形式，精修边描述边缘加工，仿石描述外观。马赛克可能采用玻璃、瓷质、陶瓷或石材。抛光、哑光、亮釉面和半抛光则描述不同表面处理。我们将实际材质、规格、表面与安装位置一起记录，以便准确评估瓷砖胶、接缝、边缘与养护。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Are a primer, moisture barrier and sealant the same as a waterproofing membrane?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 底涂、防潮阻隔层和密封胶，等同防水膜吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. A primer prepares the bonding interface, a moisture barrier addresses specified moisture or vapour conditions, and a sealant treats designated joints. Their exact roles depend on the product. We specify the main membrane and compatible junction materials separately; a moisture-control coating is not automatically a flexible wet-area membrane.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不等同。底涂处理粘结界面，防潮阻隔层针对规定的水分或水汽条件，密封胶处理指定接缝，具体作用取决于产品。我们分别明确主体防水膜及相容节点材料，不能把水分控制涂层自动当作柔性湿区防水膜。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can a water-based membrane be used on a tiled balcony?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 水性防水膜可以用于铺砖阳台吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Some products are specified for exterior under-tile use. Water-based describes the formulation medium, not an indoor-only use category. We check the exact product, substrate, weather exposure, covering and tile-adhesive compatibility. Exterior suitability does not automatically mean the membrane can remain permanently exposed.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 部分产品明确适用于室外瓷砖下。水性描述配方介质，并不等于只能室内使用。我们核对具体产品、基层、风雨暴露、覆盖层及瓷砖胶兼容性。适合室外也不自动代表防水膜可长期外露。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Does every polyurethane roof membrane resist long-term UV exposure?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 所有聚氨酯屋面防水膜都能长期耐晒吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. Polyurethane describes the chemistry, not the complete exposure rating. Some roof systems require a specified UV-resistant topcoat over the base membrane. We assess the existing roof and agree the compatible primer, membrane, detailing and protection together. A generic coating name is not a complete roof specification.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 不是。聚氨酯描述化学体系，并不代表完整的外露性能。部分屋面系统需要在主体膜上施工规定的耐紫外线面层。我们评估现有屋面，一并确定相容底涂、防水膜、节点与保护层，不能只凭涂层类别代替完整屋面选材。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Is a cementitious membrane always rigid or suitable for any pool?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 水泥基防水一定是刚性材料，或都适合泳池吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Neither assumption is reliable. Polymer-modified cementitious ranges include flexible products, but movement, immersion and water-pressure suitability are product-specific. For a pool, we check permanent immersion, the base, water treatment, tile adhesive, grout and curing before filling as one system. A membrane suitable for rain exposure is not automatically suitable for continuous immersion.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 这两种判断都不能一概而论。聚合物水泥基系列包含柔性产品，但变形、浸水及水压适用性需按具体型号确认。泳池要将长期浸水、基层、水处理、瓷砖胶、填缝与注水前养护作为完整系统核对。适合淋雨的膜不自动适合持续浸水。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Are two or three coats enough to confirm waterproofing is complete?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 刷两遍或三遍，就能确认防水完成了吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Coat count alone is not enough. The selected system specifies preparation, coverage, film thickness, junction treatment, recoat conditions and curing before covering or use. We follow those product requirements and agree any project checks. A surface that looks dry may not be ready for tiling, rain exposure or pool filling.
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 单看遍数不够。所选系统规定基层处理、涂布量、膜厚、节点处理、复涂条件及覆盖或使用前的养护。我们按产品要求安排施工并明确项目所需检查。表面看起来干燥，不一定已适合铺砖、淋雨或泳池注水。

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: Can tapes, sealants and membranes from the same brand always be mixed?
faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.target: 同品牌的防水带、密封胶和防水膜，都可以混用吗？

faq.html/html[1]/head[0]/script[28]@json.source: No. We check the nominated system’s approved components and detailing method. Corners, pipe collars, tape and bond-breaking treatments have specific roles; one approved tape detail may replace a separate bond breaker in that system, while another system needs a different method. Tile adhesive and protective topcoats also need compatibility confirmed.

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. Pooling can involve drainage, surface falls or outlet condition as well as joints and the wider waterproofing assembly. Renewing grout alone may not address the cause. Note where water collects and arrange assessment of the balcony before choosing a repair.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不一定。除接缝和整体防水构造外，积水也可能与排水、地面坡度或排水口状况有关。仅更新填缝未必能解决原因。记录积水位置，先评估阳台再选择维修。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Why assess balcony thresholds and outlets together?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 为什么要一起评估阳台门槛与排水口？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Door thresholds, outlets and adjoining junctions affect how water leaves the balcony and where it may enter the building. Their accessible condition and connection to the waterproofing need assessment together before a repair scope is agreed. Photos can help describe the area but do not confirm concealed details.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 门槛、排水口及相邻交接影响阳台排水及进入建筑的路径。确认维修范围前，应一起检查可接触部位及其与防水层的连接。照片有助于描述区域，但不能证实隐蔽细部。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Does a ceiling watermark show exactly where water enters the roof?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 天花板水印能准确显示屋顶进水位置吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. Water can travel before a mark appears, so the visible stain may be away from the entry point. Note whether moisture changes after rain and distinguish new dampness from old marks. Arrange safe assessment rather than treating the stain location as a diagnosis.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不能。水可能流动后才形成印迹，所以水渍位置可能偏离进水点。记录雨后湿度是否变化，区分新潮湿和旧印迹。应安排安全评估，不把水渍位置当作诊断。

Safe access and any separate repair work need to be agreed before application. Describe the symptoms from a safe location; do not climb onto the roof to investigate.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不能。涂层不能代替对屋顶状况、交接、排水及所选系统适用性的评估。涂刷前需确认安全通行和其他维修范围。请从安全位置描述现象，不要爬上屋顶调查。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: We install the specified wet-area waterproofing before the tiled finish, with surface preparation, drainage and junction details coordinated as part of the service. Tiles and grout alone do not provide the waterproofing layer.

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: There is no single service-life figure for every membrane. The installed system, base condition, movement, exposure and use affect performance. We assess accessible surfaces and explain any investigation or renewal needed; intact tiles alone do not establish the condition beneath them.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 所有防水膜没有统一使用年限。安装系统、基层状况、位移、暴露条件及使用方式都会影响性能。我们评估可接触表面，说明所需调查或更新；瓷砖完好不能证明下方状况。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: A local joint repair may be possible if assessment supports it. Regrouting or resealing does not replace a failed concealed membrane. We check the surface, joints and likely water-entry source, then identify any tile removal and membrane work in the written quote. The
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 评估支持时，可考虑局部接缝维修。重新填缝或密封不能替换失效的隐蔽防水膜。我们检查表面、接缝及可能进水源，并在报价中列明拆砖与膜层施工。

Waterproofing over tiles does not repair a failed concealed membrane. We inspect the area on site and specify any tile removal and preparation needed in the repair plan and written quote.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 取决于选定系统、现有瓷砖与基层状况。在砖面做防水不能修复失效的隐蔽膜层。我们到场检查，并在维修方案和报价中说明所需拆砖与基层准备。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Do I need to replace the whole bathroom?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Not every shower leak needs a whole bathroom replacement. Assessment helps distinguish a joint problem, a plumbing source and affected waterproofing. We explain whether a targeted repair is suitable or which layers and finishes need removal and renewal.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 并非每次淋浴漏水都需整体更换浴室。评估帮助区分接缝问题、管道水源及受损防水。我们说明局部维修是否适合，或哪些层次和饰面需要拆除更新。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: What if the leak is already showing downstairs?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: What is included in tile regrouting and shower resealing?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Regrouting renews grout between tiles; resealing renews silicone at movement junctions and edges. We remove the deteriorated material, prepare the included joints and install suitable replacements. Neither process replaces a failed membrane, so recurring leaks need source assessment before the repair scope is agreed.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 重新填缝更新瓷砖间填缝；重新密封更新伸缩交接和边缘硅胶。我们去除老化材料、准备约定接缝并安装适当替换材料。两者均不能替换失效膜层，反复漏水需先评估水源再确定维修。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 稳固、粘结良好且平整度和完成面高度合适时，可能适合覆盖铺砖。我们先评估这些条件、边缘及过渡，再确认范围。松砖或失效隐蔽防水层需单独处理；再加一层砖不能修复它们。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: We install your selected tiles or include tile supply in the agreed scope. We confirm quantities, format, thickness and responsibility for materials before work begins. You can contact Ellis before choosing or buying tiles.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 我们可安装您选定的瓷砖，也可按约定范围包含材料供应。开工前确认数量、规格、厚度及材料责任。选择或购买瓷砖前就可以联系 Ellis。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Why does floor flatness matter with large tiles?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 大规格瓷砖为什么重视基层平整度？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 先说明降雨规律与室内受影响部位。我们检查可安全接近的屋顶表面与节点，再确认是否适合局部防水处理。请说明何时开始漏水、已知风向及旧维修情况。书面范围会区分检查、拟定修复、进场条件，以及可能需要的进一步排查或独立屋顶工程。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Does a balcony leak after rain need new grout, joint sealing or a new membrane?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: The entry path and condition beneath the tiles determine the choice. Grout renewal treats tile joints, flexible sealing treats suitable movement junctions, and membrane renewal treats a different layer with its own removal and reinstatement scope. We check thresholds, falls, outlet connections and the accessible base before recommending what can be retained.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 应根据进水路径与砖下状况选择。填缝更新处理砖缝，弹性密封处理适用的活动接缝，防水层更新则处理另一层构造，并涉及相应拆除与恢复。我们检查门槛、坡度、排水口连接与可见基层，再建议哪些部分可以保留。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 请说明墙面朝向、何时最先受潮，以及附近阳台、屋顶边缘或窗边交接处是否同时变湿。窗边水渍本身不能定位进水来源。我们评估可安全接近的墙体防水节点；窗体、玻璃维修及独立排水工程需另行明确范围。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Why do courtyard tiles hold puddles when the surface grate is clear?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: A clear grate does not establish the condition or capacity of the pipe below. Tile-bed low spots, falls, outlet height and adjoining ground levels also influence surface drainage. We assess the tiled surface and base for a retiling scope. Suspected pipe blockage or damage needs separate drainage assessment before surface work is planned.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 格栅清洁并不能确认下方管道的状况或排水能力。铺砖层低洼、坡度、排水口高度及相邻地面高度也会影响表面排水。我们评估砖面与基层，明确重新铺砖范围。若怀疑管道堵塞或损坏，应先另行进行排水评估，再安排表面工程。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Can outdoor tiling start as soon as the surface looks dry after rain?

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Appearance alone is not a readiness check. Moisture in the substrate, the retained tile bed and existing coatings need assessment against the selected membrane and adhesive requirements. Application conditions, protection from rain and return-to-use stages can differ. We confirm the installation sequence for the materials and actual site conditions.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 仅凭外观不能判断是否具备施工条件。基层含水状况、保留铺砖层与旧涂层，需要对照所选防水材料和瓷砖胶要求进行评估。施工条件、防雨保护与恢复使用阶段可能不同。我们按实际材料与现场条件确认施工顺序。

Ceramic ranges include wall and floor products; natural stone is quarried material identified by its stone type. We check the actual product designation and intended use. The finish, weight, thickness and fixing requirements still need review for your surface.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 瓷质砖属于砖体致密、吸水率较低的陶瓷材料，但澳洲零售产品通常将 Porcelain 与 Ceramic 分列。Ceramic 系列既有墙砖也有地砖；天然石材则是按具体石种区分的开采材料。我们核对实际产品分类和用途，同时评估饰面、重量、厚度与对应表面的粘贴要求。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Are matt tiles automatically suitable for bathroom floors and pool surrounds?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 哑光砖一定适合浴室地面和泳池周边吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. Matt describes appearance, not verified slip performance. We review the selected product’s wet-use slip information and proposed location, including barefoot comfort at a pool edge. Drainage, grout joints, cleaning and the coping profile also matter. A wall tile or polished finish should not be selected for a wet floor solely because its colour matches.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不一定。哑光描述外观，并不代表经过核实的防滑表现。我们核对具体产品的湿态防滑资料和拟用位置，泳池边沿还要考虑赤脚舒适度。排水、砖缝、清洁与压顶边型也很重要。不能仅因颜色匹配，就将墙砖或抛光饰面用于湿态地面。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Which bathroom wall tiles are easier to clean, and can water marks still show?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 哪些浴室墙砖更容易清洁？还会出现水迹吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: We compare smooth glazed ceramic and porcelain with the proposed wall use and cleaning routine. A smooth surface can make wiping easier, but dried water and soap deposits may still show. Gloss and satin change the appearance; textured surfaces and mosaic joints change the cleaning detail. Use the tile and grout care instructions, and keep the separate waterproofing scope clear.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 我们结合墙面用途与日常清洁习惯，比较平滑釉面陶瓷砖和瓷质砖。平滑表面通常便于擦洗，但仍可能显现干水迹和皂垢。亮面与缎光改变外观，纹理表面和马赛克砖缝则改变清洁细节。应遵循瓷砖及填缝养护说明，同时明确独立的防水工作范围。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Which splashback tiles make cooking splashes easier to clean?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 哪些厨房防溅墙砖更方便清洁烹饪溅污？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Smooth glazed ceramic or porcelain is worth comparing with deeply textured tiles and small mosaics. Check the actual surface, exposed grout and product cleaning instructions rather than relying on a gloss or matt label. We assess tile layout, cement-based or epoxy grout suitability and the flexible benchtop junction. Materials near the cooktop also need to suit the appliance instructions and project requirements.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 可将平滑釉面陶瓷砖或瓷质砖，与深纹理砖和小规格马赛克进行比较。应核对实际表面、外露填缝及产品清洁说明，不能仅凭亮面或哑光名称判断。我们评估排砖、水泥基或环氧填缝的适用性，以及台面弹性接缝。灶具附近材料还需符合电器说明与项目要求。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Do stone, terrazzo and cement tiles need the same care as porcelain?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 石材、水磨石和水泥砖的养护与瓷质砖相同吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Use the actual material’s care instructions. Marble, limestone and travertine can be affected by acidic cleaners, while real terrazzo, cement and terracotta products may have specific sealing requirements. Sealing is not a substitute for a wet-area membrane or a promise against every stain. Stone-look or terrazzo-look porcelain is porcelain with that appearance, not the natural or cement-based material it resembles.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 应按实际材质的养护说明处理。大理石、石灰石和洞石可能受酸性清洁剂影响，真正水磨石、水泥砖和陶土砖可能有特定封护要求。封护不能代替湿区防水层，也不代表能抵御所有污渍。仿石或仿水磨石瓷质砖仍是相应外观的瓷质砖，并非它所模仿的天然或水泥基材料。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Do mosaic, rectified and stone-look identify the tile material?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 马赛克、精修边与仿石，说明的是瓷砖材质吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. Mosaic describes a format, rectified describes the edge treatment and stone-look describes appearance. A mosaic may be glass, porcelain, ceramic or stone. Polished, matt, gloss and lappato describe different surface finishes. We record the actual material, size, finish and installation location together so the adhesive, joints, edges and care can be assessed correctly.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不是。马赛克描述形式，精修边描述边缘加工，仿石描述外观。马赛克可能采用玻璃、瓷质、陶瓷或石材。抛光、哑光、亮釉面和半抛光则描述不同表面处理。我们将实际材质、规格、表面与安装位置一起记录，以便准确评估瓷砖胶、接缝、边缘与养护。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Are a primer, moisture barrier and sealant the same as a waterproofing membrane?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 底涂、防潮阻隔层和密封胶，等同防水膜吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. A primer prepares the bonding interface, a moisture barrier addresses specified moisture or vapour conditions, and a sealant treats designated joints. Their exact roles depend on the product. We specify the main membrane and compatible junction materials separately; a moisture-control coating is not automatically a flexible wet-area membrane.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不等同。底涂处理粘结界面，防潮阻隔层针对规定的水分或水汽条件，密封胶处理指定接缝，具体作用取决于产品。我们分别明确主体防水膜及相容节点材料，不能把水分控制涂层自动当作柔性湿区防水膜。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Can a water-based membrane be used on a tiled balcony?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 水性防水膜可以用于铺砖阳台吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Some products are specified for exterior under-tile use. Water-based describes the formulation medium, not an indoor-only use category. We check the exact product, substrate, weather exposure, covering and tile-adhesive compatibility. Exterior suitability does not automatically mean the membrane can remain permanently exposed.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 部分产品明确适用于室外瓷砖下。水性描述配方介质，并不等于只能室内使用。我们核对具体产品、基层、风雨暴露、覆盖层及瓷砖胶兼容性。适合室外也不自动代表防水膜可长期外露。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Does every polyurethane roof membrane resist long-term UV exposure?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 所有聚氨酯屋面防水膜都能长期耐晒吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. Polyurethane describes the chemistry, not the complete exposure rating. Some roof systems require a specified UV-resistant topcoat over the base membrane. We assess the existing roof and agree the compatible primer, membrane, detailing and protection together. A generic coating name is not a complete roof specification.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不是。聚氨酯描述化学体系，并不代表完整的外露性能。部分屋面系统需要在主体膜上施工规定的耐紫外线面层。我们评估现有屋面，一并确定相容底涂、防水膜、节点与保护层，不能只凭涂层类别代替完整屋面选材。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Is a cementitious membrane always rigid or suitable for any pool?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 水泥基防水一定是刚性材料，或都适合泳池吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Neither assumption is reliable. Polymer-modified cementitious ranges include flexible products, but movement, immersion and water-pressure suitability are product-specific. For a pool, we check permanent immersion, the base, water treatment, tile adhesive, grout and curing before filling as one system. A membrane suitable for rain exposure is not automatically suitable for continuous immersion.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 这两种判断都不能一概而论。聚合物水泥基系列包含柔性产品，但变形、浸水及水压适用性需按具体型号确认。泳池要将长期浸水、基层、水处理、瓷砖胶、填缝与注水前养护作为完整系统核对。适合淋雨的膜不自动适合持续浸水。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Are two or three coats enough to confirm waterproofing is complete?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 刷两遍或三遍，就能确认防水完成了吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Coat count alone is not enough. The selected system specifies preparation, coverage, film thickness, junction treatment, recoat conditions and curing before covering or use. We follow those product requirements and agree any project checks. A surface that looks dry may not be ready for tiling, rain exposure or pool filling.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 单看遍数不够。所选系统规定基层处理、涂布量、膜厚、节点处理、复涂条件及覆盖或使用前的养护。我们按产品要求安排施工并明确项目所需检查。表面看起来干燥，不一定已适合铺砖、淋雨或泳池注水。

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: Can tapes, sealants and membranes from the same brand always be mixed?
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 同品牌的防水带、密封胶和防水膜，都可以混用吗？

faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.source: No. We check the nominated system’s approved components and detailing method. Corners, pipe collars, tape and bond-breaking treatments have specific roles; one approved tape detail may replace a separate bond breaker in that system, while another system needs a different method. Tile adhesive and protective topcoats also need compatibility confirmed.
faq.html/html[1]/body[2]/main[3]/section.target: 不能默认混用。我们核对选定系统认可的配件及节点方法。转角件、管根套环、防水带和隔粘处理各有作用；某系统认可的防水带做法可能替代独立隔粘材料，其他系统则可能采用不同做法。瓷砖胶与保护面层也需确认兼容性。
